formProperties.styleSheet: QWidget { font-family: 'Segoe UI'; font-size: 9pt; color: #263445; } QLabel#header { background: #17324d; color: white; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: 600; padding-left: 18px; } QLabel#section { font-size: 11pt; font-weight: 600; color: #24364b; } QLabel#card { background: #f5f7fa; border: 1px solid #d9e1ea; padding: 14px; font-size: 11pt; } QLabel#chart { background: white; border: 1px solid #d9e1ea; padding: 12px; color: #176b87; font-family: Consolas; font-size: 14pt; }

properties.sql: select p.product_id,p.name,coalesce(p.brand,'') as brand,(select pp.price from price_points pp where pp.source=p.source and pp.product_id=p.product_id order by pp.captured_at desc,pp.id desc limit 1) as current_price,case when p.status='out_of_stock' then 'Нет в наличии' when coalesce(p.tracking_enabled,1)=0 then 'Не отслеживается' when p.favorite_state='not_in_favorites' then 'Убрано из избранного' else coalesce(p.status,'') end as status from products p where p.source='ozon' order by p.name collate nocase
properties.styleSheet: QTableView {  gridline-color: #c0c0c0;  font-family: 'MS Shell Dlg 2';  font-size: 8.25pt;}QTableView::item:selected {  background-color: #0078d7;  color: white;}QTableView::item:selected:!active {  background-color: #0078d7;  color: white;}QHeaderView::section {  background-color: #f0f0f0;  border: 1px solid #d0d0d0;  padding: 2px 4px;  font-weight: normal;}

properties.sql: select pp.captured_at,p.name,case when pp.price=cast(pp.price as integer) then replace(printf('%,d',cast(pp.price as integer)),',',' ') else replace(replace(printf('%,.2f',pp.price),',',' '),'.',',') end as price,(select case when prev.price=cast(prev.price as integer) then replace(printf('%,d',cast(prev.price as integer)),',',' ') else replace(replace(printf('%,.2f',prev.price),',',' '),'.',',') end from price_points prev where prev.source=pp.source and prev.product_id=pp.product_id and (prev.captured_at<pp.captured_at or (prev.captured_at=pp.captured_at and prev.id<pp.id)) order by prev.captured_at desc,prev.id desc limit 1) as previous_price,pp.currency from price_points pp join products p on p.source=pp.source and p.product_id=pp.product_id where pp.source='ozon' order by pp.captured_at desc,pp.id desc limit 40
